summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Nuveen ESG International Developed Markets Equity ETF (NUDM) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI Nuveen ESG International DM index. The fund tracks an index of companies from developed countries, excluding the US and Canada, that align with various environmental, social, and governance principles. NUDM was launched on Jun 7, 2017 and is issued by Nuveen.

holdings.infoBox: NUDM is an equity ETF with a total of 155 individual holdings. The top holdings are ASML Holding stock at 4.34%, Novartis AG at 2.30%, Siemens Aktiengesellschaft at 2.29%, Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group at 2.06%, and SAP SE at 2.05%.
